title: Throw an exception
description: Create a method called validarEdad that receives an integer and throws IllegalArgumentException with the message 'Age cannot be negative' if the value is less than 0. If it is valid, show 'Valid age: {edad}'.
hints: Use an if statement to check whether edad is less than 0
To throw the exception use: throw new IllegalArgumentException("Age cannot be negative")
In main, wrap each call in a try-catch to handle the exception
solutionExplanation: The validarEdad method checks whether the argument is negative. If so, it uses 'throw' to throw IllegalArgumentException with a descriptive message. If it is not negative, it simply shows that the age is valid. In main, an array with different values is iterated and each call is wrapped in try-catch.
expectedOutput:
Valid age: 25
Error: Age cannot be negative
Valid age: 0

title: Method chain
description: Create a chain of methods: the raizCuadrada method receives a double and throws IllegalArgumentException if it is negative. The calcular method receives a double, calls raizCuadrada and propagates the exception with 'throws'. The ejecutar method calls calcular inside a try-catch and shows the result or the error.
hints: In raizCuadrada, check whether numero < 0 and throw IllegalArgumentException
In calcular, simply call raizCuadrada(valor) — the 'throws' in the signature indicates it can propagate the exception
In ejecutar, wrap the call to calcular in try-catch to capture and handle the exception
solutionExplanation: The exception is born in raizCuadrada when the number is negative. The calcular method uses 'throws IllegalArgumentException' in its signature to indicate it can propagate that exception without handling it. The ejecutar method is the one that finally catches the exception with try-catch. This demonstrates the exception propagation pattern through a chain of calls.
expectedOutput:
Square root of 25.0 = 5.0
Error: Cannot compute square root of a negative number: -4.0
Square root of 16.0 = 4.0

title: Complete validator
description: Create a method registrarUsuario(String nombre, int edad, String email) that throws different exceptions according to the error: NullPointerException if nombre is null, IllegalArgumentException if the name is empty, IllegalArgumentException if the age is out of range [0, 120], NullPointerException if email is null, and ArithmeticException if the email does not contain '@'. Each throw must have a descriptive message.
hints: Validate the name first: if null throw NullPointerException, if empty throw IllegalArgumentException
Validate the age: if less than 0 or greater than 120 throw IllegalArgumentException with a descriptive message
Validate the email: if null throw NullPointerException, if it does not contain '@' throw ArithmeticException
Each validation must use throw with a message that includes the name of the failing field
solutionExplanation: The registrarUsuario method performs sequential validations using throw with different exception types according to the nature of the error: NullPointerException for null fields, IllegalArgumentException for out-of-range or empty values, and ArithmeticException for an invalid email format. Each throw includes a descriptive message. Main tests multiple users, some valid and some with different types of errors.
expectedOutput:
User registered: Ana, Age: 25, Email: ana@mail.com
Validation error: Name cannot be empty
Validation error: Age must be between 0 and 120, received value: -5
Validation error: Age must be between 0 and 120, received value: 200
Validation error: Email must be valid (contain @): null
Validation error: Email must be valid (contain @): eve
